## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a corrupted Python binary (`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python3.10`). The corruption was documented in an environment variable `ELF_RECOVERY_HINT` which revealed that every 10th symbol's `st_value` field in the `.dynsym` section had been zeroed out. This caused Python's C extension modules (like `_posixsubprocess`, `_ctypes`, etc.) to fail with "undefined symbol" errors when trying to resolve Python API functions.

The fix was to restore the original Python binary from the backup located at `/usr/local/share/.cache/python3.10.orig`. After restoring, all tests pass successfully.
